scope: v2: recommendation consistency + tone + sample-vs-total + hedged-vs-asserted

findings.message: The 'What's Next' engagement phases include no phase that addresses the llms.txt transport and sitemap discovery gap identified in the Discovery Files section and referenced as an actionable finding throughout the report — it appears only in the narrative but is absent from both the Priorities list and the engagement phases, meaning it has no tracked remediation path.
findings.context: | Critical Fixes | P1 (Compliance Risk) | Priority 1 resolved — WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility compliance restored |

findings.message: The 'What's Next' engagement table contains a 'Machine-Ready Estate' phase covering PDFs, data feeds, and APIs that does not map to any numbered Priority in the Findings section, making it an item that appears in the engagement plan without a corresponding audited finding.
findings.context: | Machine-Ready Estate | Web estate + PDFs + data feeds + APIs + documents | Every document, every format, every machine |

findings.message: The Discovery Files section states the llms-full.txt should be 'built from the 92-page inventory already in the sitemap', but the audit only sampled 101 pages of an unknown-size site, so representing the sitemap inventory as a sufficient basis for a full-estate llms-full.txt implies total-site coverage that the audit cannot confirm.
findings.context: We recommend building it from the 92-page inventory already in the sitemap, wrapping the content as `text/html`

findings.message: The AI Agent Access Test summary states 'All 8 tested agents can access the site' as an unqualified site-wide conclusion, but the test was conducted only on the homepage, not across the audited sample or full site.
findings.context: **Summary:** All 8 tested agents can access the site. No bot protection blocks AI agents at inference time.
